text: しかし　ひとから　おそわらなければ　おぼえない　わざも　あるぞ

structure.jp: ひとから　おそわらなければ　おぼえない　わざも
structure.en: moves they won't learn unless taught by a person, too

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: なければ on a verb means 'if it does not happen', so 'unless'. おそわらなければ = 'unless they are taught'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おそわらなければ　おぼえない　わざ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. おそわらなければおぼえないわざ = 'moves they won't learn unless taught'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way to push a point home. あるぞ = 'there are, I tell you'.
